# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens in parallel belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a known number of seconds), `variable` (a range with min, max and default), or `indefinite` (runs until the operator stops it). A **startTrigger** ties a step to the clock or to another step—`programStart` (at t=0), `programStartOffset` (at t=offset), `afterStep` (when another step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when another step ends plus a delay), `manual` (the operator taps to start), `onAbort` (if another step is aborted), or `compound` (wait for all or the first of several triggers). **stepId**s are unique across the WHOLE program, not per track—no two steps can share an ID even if they are in different tracks. Every `task` a step occupies needs a matching `resourceConstraints` entry, and that entry's `maxConcurrent` is what prevents two steps from using one biosafety cabinet, one centrifuge, one microscope, etc. at the same instant. Work repeated n times (n flasks, n samples, n wells) is declared once as `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on ONE step—never n hand-copied steps. Chain what follows each repetition with `{"type":"afterStep","stepId":"<step>","instances":"each"}`, give the step that waits for all instances `{"instances":"all"}`, and when the holding area between them only fits k at a time (e.g. a microscope eyepiece that can only examine one slide, or an incubator with limited shelf space) set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` to hold the upstream step back instead of stranding the downstream one.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "biosafety_cabinet", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "water_bath", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "incubator", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "centrifuge", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "microscope", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
